site.note: Brandon (Bao Dinh), video editor and motion designer from Ho Chi Minh City. Every job here is a different kind of work, so every folder looks like the work inside it. Pull a tab to open it.

projects.title: Họa Kiếng
txt: The intro for our Art and Culture project at UEH SMD. I took the painted frame, the lotus, the dragons and the figures from tranh kiếng and let them move.
projects.fine: I do not own the artworks in this video. This project is for educational purpose only.

projects.title: The Print Gap
projects.lede: A talkshow about the gap between the design on your screen and the print that comes off the press.
txt: A designer and a production operator sit down to find one shared language, because creativity only takes off when it can step into the real world.
My part was the edit and everything that moves, from the first frame of the intro to the closing title.
credits: Team Xuất Thần · Media Production course, UEH

projects.title: Lục Vận Khai Xuân
projects.ctx: Lunar New Year culture project · UEH
projects.lede: From the brush-stroke intro to the booth on the day.
txt: Motion, edit and filming for our Lunar New Year culture project at UEH.

projects.title: Arttech K51
projects.ctx: Digital Illustration × Visual LED Performance · SMD
txt: A recap film for the K51 students’ final projects at SMD, School of Media Design. I made the motion: the opening type, the cube city outro, the card burst and the blue grid end title, built to carry every student’s piece without stealing the spotlight.

projects.title: Module on X
projects.lede: Motion design for a school safety program: the trailer for its module on X.
txt: Interfaces turning in 3D space, flat icons stamped on graph paper, and the app’s screens one after another, all on the grid from the opening title.

projects.title: Motion Shorts
projects.lede: Talking heads up front, and the motion that carries the hard parts.
txt: Type that lands word by word, numbers that grow, documents highlighted line by line.
